subject: Science
stem: A science teacher keeps a stock of safety goggles, and insists students tie back hair and never taste chemicals during practical sessions. This attention to safe laboratory practice is important mainly because it:

options.option_text: Prevents accidents and injuries during hands-on scientific investigation
Makes the lesson take much longer with no other benefit
Is only relevant for chemistry, not other sciences
Has no impact on the quality of learning

explanation: Laboratory safety practices prevent accidents during hands-on experimentation, an essential part of responsible science pedagogy whenever students work directly with materials, heat, or chemicals.
